segments.text: Lesson 33
segments.translation: 第33课

segments.text: Education
segments.translation: 教育

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Why is education democratic in bookless tribal societies?
segments.translation: 为什么在无书部落社会中教育是民主的？

segments.text: Education is one of the key words of our time.
segments.translation: 教育是我们这个时代的关键词之一。

segments.text: A man without an education, many of us believe,
segments.translation: 我们许多人相信，一个没有受过教育的人，

segments.text: is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances, deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities.
segments.translation: 是不利环境的不幸受害者，被剥夺了二十世纪最伟大的机会之一。

segments.text: Convinced of the importance of education, modern states 'invest' in institutions of learning to get back 'interest'
segments.translation: 现代国家深信教育的重要性，对学习机构进行“投资”以收回“兴趣”

segments.text: in the form of a large group of enlightened young men and women who are potential leaders.
segments.translation: 以一大群开明的年轻男女为形式，他们是潜在的领导者。

segments.text: Education, with its cycles of instruction so carefully worked out,
segments.translation: 教育的教学周期经过精心设计，

segments.text: punctuated by textbooks--those purchasable wells of wisdom--what would civilization be like without its benefits?
segments.translation: 夹杂着教科书——那些可以购买的智慧之井——如果没有它的好处，文明会是什么样子？

segments.text: So much is certain: that we would have doctors and preachers,
segments.translation: 非常确定的是：我们会有医生和传教士，

segments.text: lawyers and defendants marriages and births--but our spiritual outlook would be different.
segments.translation: 律师和被告的婚姻和出生——但我们的精神面貌会有所不同。

segments.text: We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory,
segments.translation: 我们会更少强调“事实和数字”，而更多地强调良好的记忆力，

segments.text: on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens.
segments.translation: 应用心理学以及一个人与同胞相处的能力。

segments.text: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.
segments.translation: 如果我们的教育体系是按照过去无书本的方式建立的，我们就会拥有可以想象到的最民主的“大学”形式。

segments.text: Among tribal people all knowledge inherited by tradition is shared by all;
segments.translation: 在部落人民中，所有传统继承的知识都是所有人共享的；

segments.text: it is taught to every member of the tribe so that in this respect everybody is equally equipped for life.
segments.translation: 它被传授给部落的每个成员，以便在这方面每个人都平等地为生活做好准备。

segments.text: It is the ideal condition of the 'equal start' which only our most progressive forms of modern education try to regain.
segments.translation: 这是“平等起点”的理想条件，只有我们最进步的现代教育形式才试图重新获得这种条件。

segments.text: In primitive cultures the obligation to seek and to receive the traditional instruction is binding to all.
segments.translation: 在原始文化中，寻求和接受传统指导的义务对所有人都有约束力。

segments.text: There are no'illiterates' --if the term can be applied to peoples without a script--while our own compulsory school attendance became law in Germany in 1642,
segments.translation: 不存在‘文盲’——如果这个词可以适用于没有文字的人的话——而我们自己的义务教育在 1642 年在德国成为法律，

segments.text: in France in 1806, and in England in 1876 and is still nonexistent in a number of 'civilized' nations.
segments.translation: 1806 年在法国，1876 年在英国，但在许多“文明”国家仍然不存在。

segments.text: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure
segments.translation: 这表明我们花了多长时间才认为有必要确保

segments.text: that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries.
segments.translation: 我们所有的孩子都可以分享过去几个世纪中“少数幸运儿”所积累的知识。

segments.text: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means.
segments.translation: 荒野教育不是金钱问题。

segments.text: All are entitled to an equal start.
segments.translation: 所有人都有权享有平等的起点。

segments.text: There is none of the hurry which, in our society, often hampers the full development of a growing personality.
segments.translation: 在我们的社会中，没有任何匆忙常常会阻碍成长中的个性的充分发展。

segments.text: There, a child grows up under the everpresent attention of his parents;
segments.translation: 在那里，孩子在父母无时无刻的关注下成长；

segments.text: therefore the jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency'.
segments.translation: 因此，丛林和大草原上不存在“青少年犯罪”。

segments.text: No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children, and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.
segments.translation: 离家谋生的必要性不会导致对孩子的忽视，也没有哪个父亲会面临无法为孩子“购买”教育的情况。
